title: strobilanthes crenulata
intro: Strobilanthes crenulata, commonly known as the "Blue Mountain Flower" or "Gurhal", is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in various folk medicine practices to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Strobilanthes crenulata are believed to be attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit anti-diabetic properties, among others. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
